svg.title: ModVigil — Reddit moderation automation · Devvit
svg.desc: Feature 2 of 5: ModVigil — Reddit moderation automation · Devvit. Status: built, for Reddit Mod Tools Hackathon 2026. A second pair of eyes for Reddit moderators. Turns a subreddit’s raw mod log into a live dashboard and runs the routine safety work automatically — humans still make every final call. Fig. 4, what it automates: Spike alerts — modmail when removals hit 3× the hourly baseline (checked every 15 min); Progressive warnings — educational note → final warning → flagged for human review; Ghost-mod detection — surfaces moderators inactive for 30+ days; Weekly digest — week-over-week report every Monday. Stack: Reddit Devvit, TypeScript, React, Redis. Link: github.com/harshbhx/modvigil.
